exposure: timing of diabetes diagnosis (before pregnancy vs. during pregnancy)
cohort: The study included 415 pregnant women diagnosed with pregestational diabetes mellitus (PGDM) who were hospitalized at Dongguan People's Hospital between June 2016 and December 2023.
finding: Pregnant women diagnosed with diabetes during pregnancy exhibited more severe perinatal glucose metabolism disorders and a higher rate of macrosomia compared to those diagnosed before pregnancy.
